chapters.en: Electrical quantities: reading power, energy, voltage and apparent power
chapters.zh: 电气量基础：功率、电量、电压与视在功率
chapters.intents: W, kW, kWh, V, A, Ah, VA, kVA, power factor; 功率 电量 伏特 安培 安时 功率因数
chapters.foundation: Power is a rate; energy accumulates over time. Voltage and current describe different electrical quantities. In AC equipment, real-power and apparent-power limits may differ, so a kW rating and a kVA rating should not be assumed interchangeable. Power factor relates real power to apparent power under the stated conditions. [D01]
body: Read a number together with its unit and its purpose. A panel's kW rating describes a generating capability at reference conditions; an inverter's kW describes a conversion or output limit; a battery's kWh describes stored energy at a defined boundary. These can all appear on the same proposal while answering different questions. Converting all of them into a single 'system size' loses important information.

For a constant load, energy equals power multiplied by elapsed time. If power varies, add the energy in successive intervals or use a representative measured total. Nameplate input may describe a maximum or test condition rather than a continuously drawn load. A refrigerator, air conditioner and water pump can each spend time in different operating states.

Amp-hours describe charge, not complete household energy. Nominal volts multiplied by amp-hours can provide an approximate nominal Wh figure. The result needs the correct battery or bank boundary: do not use one cell's voltage with the entire bank's claimed Ah, or treat a nominal DC figure as usable AC output. Voltage varies and the equipment specification remains the reference.

Apparent power is relevant when reviewing equipment that carries separate VA and W limits. If a hypothetical load has real power of 1.2 kW and power factor 0.8, the corresponding apparent power is 1.5 kVA. That arithmetic is an explanation, not a recommendation for a customer's circuit or UPS. Starting behaviour, harmonics and equipment limits still need professional assessment.

A good customer explanation keeps these layers separate: how much power is needed at once, how much energy is needed over a period, and which supply and equipment characteristics must be compatible. This lets the customer describe a goal without being asked to perform electrical measurements or expose wiring.
chapters.check: Ask for a model label or manufacturer specification where available, the operating hours and which loads run together. Never ask the customer to open an electrical enclosure to obtain a reading.
chapters.cn: 读参数先看单位和对象。kW 表示某一时刻的功率，kWh 表示一段时间内的电量，Ah 不能脱离电压直接当作家用可用电量。电池容量、逆变器输出和组件额定功率分别回答不同问题。对于带 kVA 额定值的设备，还要区分实际功率与视在功率。客服应帮助客户理解参数，具体电气匹配交给工程师。

chapters.en: Solar resource: daylight, irradiance, daily energy and weather uncertainty
chapters.zh: 太阳能资源：日照、辐照度、每日能量与天气变化
chapters.intents: sun hours, irradiance, insolation, peak sun hours, seasons, forecast; 日照 辐照度 峰值日照 阴天 季节
chapters.foundation: Solar-performance models distinguish weather inputs, the light reaching the panel plane and the conditions influencing electrical output. A measurement at one instant is different from energy integrated across a day. Effective irradiance further accounts for optical effects such as soiling and angle of incidence. [D02, D03]
body: Day length is not a promise of rated generation throughout those hours. Morning, midday and late afternoon can have very different light intensity. A rooftop may also move into and out of shade. This is why a useful energy forecast is based on a time profile rather than panel capacity multiplied by every daylight hour.

Equivalent full-sun hours compress a changing daily light profile into an energy-equivalent number. They do not mean that the roof receives an unchanging peak intensity for that exact continuous period. When using an illustrative number in a conversation, label it as an assumption rather than a measured fact about the customer's island or roof.

Distinguish location-level resource from site-level access. A sunny region can still contain a deeply shaded roof. Nearby structures, trees, roof orientation and the usable installation area affect what the proposed array receives. A regional forecast does not substitute for a layout assessment.

An annual average is useful for planning but cannot describe every day, month or outage event. A design chosen for average bill reduction may need a different reserve or backup strategy for several weak-sun days. Weather-year data, actual future weather and a single forecast are different kinds of evidence.

A practical conversation starts with the customer's objective. Someone mainly concerned with bill reduction may want an annual estimate and its assumptions. Someone worried about long outages needs an explanation of low-generation periods, storage and any supported additional energy source. The assistant should not turn a regional sunshine statement into an autonomy guarantee.
chapters.check: Ask which period and objective the customer is discussing: an instant, a typical day, an annual estimate or a specific outage. Use local site information before giving a project forecast.
chapters.cn: 日照时长、辐照强度和一天得到的太阳能量不是同一个量。峰值日照小时是等效表示，不是每天固定满功率运行的小时数。地区晴朗也不能证明某个屋顶无遮挡。年平均发电估算与连续阴天的备电能力要分别分析；没有当地屋顶和气象资料时，不提供固定发电承诺。

chapters.en: Photovoltaic cells and module technologies: understanding comparisons
chapters.zh: 光伏电池与组件技术：怎样理解技术路线
chapters.intents: silicon, monocrystalline, polycrystalline, thin film, bifacial, tandem; 单晶 多晶 薄膜 双面 叠层 组件效率
chapters.foundation: Photovoltaic cells use semiconductor structures to convert light into electrical energy. Crystalline silicon and thin-film technologies are broad families. Bifacial collection and tandem structures describe different design features; a technology label alone is not a complete system specification. [D04]
body: A cell is the converting element; a module packages many cells into an outdoor generating product. The resulting module still needs appropriate electrical conversion, mounting and system controls. A strong laboratory cell result does not establish a particular rooftop product's dimensions, price, availability or lifetime performance.

Customers often hear several labels at once and assume they are competing descriptions of the same property. Some refer to the semiconductor material, some to how the cell is constructed, some to how light is collected, and others to module packaging. Ask for the exact proposed model rather than inferring every feature from one marketing term.

Compare products at the level that matters to the roof. Relevant information includes rated output, physical size, efficiency, temperature behaviour, applicable tests and the terms covering equipment and output. On a constrained roof, power per available area may matter; on another project, layout or shading can dominate the decision.

A bifacial module can only benefit from light that actually reaches its rear. Roof colour, clearance and mounting geometry influence that opportunity. 'Two sides' is not an instruction to double the estimate. Likewise, a research report about a tandem cell is not proof that a quoted module uses that technology or is available through Sol & Tide.

A useful response to 'Which technology is best?' is to identify the comparison goal. Is the customer short of roof area, concerned about hot operating conditions, trying to fit an unusual roof, or comparing warranty documents? The assistant can explain those criteria and direct the model-specific choice to the proposal.
chapters.check: Use the company's confirmed equipment information for offered products. Treat external manufacturers and research examples as educational references, not an approved supplier list.
chapters.cn: 组件技术名词描述的可能是材料、结构、封装或采光方式，不能只凭一个词判断整套系统好坏。实验室电池效率也不等于屋顶组件的实际收益。比较应落到具体型号的功率、尺寸、温度表现、测试文件和保修条件。双面组件需要背面实际获得光照，不能直接把发电量翻倍。

chapters.en: Reading a panel datasheet without turning it into a wiring plan
chapters.zh: 看懂组件参数表：额定值、工作点与测试条件
chapters.intents: Pmax, Voc, Isc, Vmp, Imp, STC, NMOT, temperature coefficient; 开路电压 短路电流 最大功率点 标准测试条件
chapters.foundation: A module's current-voltage relationship includes short-circuit current, open-circuit voltage and a maximum-power operating point. These quantities vary with conditions, including irradiance and cell temperature. A datasheet's reference conditions must therefore accompany its numerical values. [D05]
body: Pmax is a power rating at stated conditions. Vmp and Imp describe voltage and current at the maximum-power operating point; their product is associated with that power. Voc describes open-circuit voltage, while Isc describes short-circuit current under the relevant conditions. These are not interchangeable versions of one operating current or voltage.

A customer reading the largest number on each row may accidentally combine values that do not occur together. Multiplying open-circuit voltage by short-circuit current does not describe the module's normal useful output. The operating point lies on a relationship between current and voltage, not a menu from which maximum values can be independently selected.

Test-condition ratings help make controlled comparisons. Operating conditions on a real roof differ. A hot sunny afternoon, a cooler bright period and a cloudy morning can each produce a different electrical state. Where a datasheet offers additional operating-temperature or performance information, ask the designer how it was used in the site estimate.

Temperature coefficients indicate a direction and scale of change for a specified parameter and reference. Do not apply a power coefficient to voltage or a voltage coefficient to energy without the appropriate model. A simplified example can teach sensitivity, but it is not a final performance calculation.

Input-voltage, current and MPPT constraints belong to the complete design. The support assistant may explain what these headings mean, but should not instruct a visitor to choose a string length, rearrange connectors or override an inverter limit. The model, site extremes and professional design all matter.
chapters.check: For a model-specific question, request the published model designation or datasheet through an appropriate channel. Do not infer compatibility from wattage alone or direct a customer to make open-circuit or short-circuit tests.
chapters.cn: Pmax、Vmp、Imp、Voc、Isc 对应不同状态，不能把每栏最大值随意相乘当作正常发电功率。额定值要与测试条件一起理解，屋顶运行会受光照和电池片温度影响。客服可以解释参数含义，但不据此在线指导组件串并联、测短路电流或调整接线。

chapters.en: Inverters, MPPT, conversion limits and the meaning of compatible operation
chapters.zh: 逆变器与 MPPT：转换、限功率和兼容性
chapters.intents: inverter, MPPT, clipping, grid following, grid forming, hybrid; 逆变器 混合逆变器 削峰 限功率 并网 构网
chapters.foundation: MPPT is a control function that seeks a useful maximum-power operating point as conditions change. The array, converter and AC output each have limits. A control function does not create sunlight or remove those limits. [D06]
body: Think of the inverter as part of a conversion and control chain. It must work with the available solar input, supported battery arrangement and the household or grid interface. The nameplate output is important, but it is not a complete description of charging limits, backup coverage, generator behaviour or transfer performance.

Different functions can be combined into one enclosure or provided by separate devices. This changes neither the need to check compatibility nor the need to identify each function. A hybrid label may indicate coordinated solar and battery operation, but a proposal still needs to state what happens in grid-connected operation and during an outage.

An inverter can limit output for more than one reason. A conversion ceiling, battery charging limit, export constraint, selected mode or protective operating condition may all influence measured output. A flat section on a graph alone does not establish which condition is responsible. Ask for context before naming it a fault.

DC panel capacity and AC conversion capacity need not match numerically. A designer may balance better use during lower-light periods against some capped output during strong conditions. That trade-off is different from exceeding a manufacturer's allowed input range. The assistant can explain the distinction without recommending equipment changes.

When a visitor compares two inverters, organise the question around the intended job: required simultaneous load, battery interface, desired backup circuits, supply arrangement, supported monitoring and future plans. A higher headline kW rating is useful only if the rest of the proposed system and site can use it.
chapters.check: Keep the distinction between a general operating concept and a verified capability of a specific model. Refer unusual source-combination or backup questions to the project team.
chapters.cn: 逆变器既涉及电能转换，也涉及与组件、电池、电网及负载的协调。MPPT 帮助寻找合适工作点，但不能产生额外太阳能。图上出现限功率可能有多种原因，不能只看曲线就认定故障。混合逆变器的名称也不能代替对备电回路、切换性能和兼容性的逐项确认。

chapters.en: Site assessment: the roof, usable space, access and equipment location
chapters.zh: 现场评估：屋顶、可用空间、施工通道与设备位置
chapters.intents: roof assessment, renovation, flat roof, access, battery location; 屋顶检查 平屋顶 结构 安装空间
chapters.foundation: Professional assessment considers the actual site, not only the desired capacity. Layout, installation access, roof condition and equipment location can affect design and scope. This guide describes information to discuss, not a structural certificate or local installation rule. [D07]
body: Separate gross area from usable area. A large roof can contain obstacles, incompatible surfaces, shaded sections and access needs. The useful layout is not obtained by dividing roof area by one panel's dimensions and ignoring everything between them. Two properties with the same floor area can support very different layouts.

Roof condition is a lifecycle issue. If substantial work is already planned, installation timing should be coordinated so that removal and reinstatement are considered early. The assistant should not promise that roof work is included, that every roof can carry the equipment, or that one photograph settles structural suitability.

Equipment space has several dimensions: physical fit, environmental suitability, permitted access and how the proposed system connects with the property's infrastructure. A battery's footprint is not the same as the complete installation envelope. A sheltered-looking location also needs model-specific assessment.

Photos can help the team understand a site, but do not request unsafe access. Useful images are those the customer can share without climbing or opening equipment. State what the image is intended to show, such as the overall roof or the proposed ground-level area. Do not treat an image as proof of hidden structure or wiring.

Present unknown site details as questions for the assessment, not obstacles that the assistant has already diagnosed. A concise enquiry might establish the island, whether the building is existing or under construction, the main goal and whether relevant photos are available. The project team can determine which additional information is needed.
chapters.check: Ask what is known, record what remains unverified, and keep preliminary discussions separate from a final design. Local requirements and model-specific location limits need confirmation.
chapters.cn: 现场评估不仅看屋顶面积，还看遮挡、结构状态、检修通道、计划中的屋顶工程和设备环境。电池自身尺寸不等于完整安装空间。照片只能辅助了解情况，不能证明隐蔽结构和电气条件，也不能要求客户爬屋顶或打开设备取证。

chapters.en: Battery construction, chemistry and protective control layers
chapters.zh: 电池结构、化学体系与保护层级
chapters.intents: cell, module, pack, LFP, NMC, BMS, EMS, cell balancing; 电芯 模组 电池包 磷酸铁锂 电池管理
chapters.foundation: Battery cells, their managed grouping and system controls perform different jobs. A battery management system monitors and constrains battery operation, while wider controls coordinate energy use. A favourable chemistry description is not a complete safety or compatibility evaluation. [D08]
body: An individual cell is not the whole home-storage product. Cells may be assembled into modules and a larger pack or bank with monitoring, protection, enclosures and interfaces. A comparison that quotes a cell's laboratory characteristic may not describe energy delivered by the installed system at household circuits.

Chemistry names are useful categories, but customers usually need an application-level comparison. Ask which documented usable energy, output limits, operating environment, support and warranty apply to the proposed product. Avoid a universal statement that one chemistry never ages or removes every risk.

Protective controls are not optional conveniences. A limit on charging or discharging may be related to conditions reported by the battery and the rest of the system. The fact that a customer wants more output does not establish that a protective limit is unnecessary. General support should not suggest defeating it.

Balancing and battery-state estimation are different ideas. Keeping cells within their intended operating relationship does not mean every displayed charge percentage must be exact at every instant. Equally, a changed percentage alone cannot identify a failed cell or justify a replacement recommendation from the chatbot.

Where equipment is modular, expansion still needs a supported combination. Communication, firmware compatibility, permissible configuration and manufacturer requirements matter alongside nominal capacity and voltage. The assistant can help the customer gather model information while leaving the actual compatibility decision to the team.
chapters.check: For chemistry or BMS questions, explain the role of the component and use confirmed product documents for actual limits. Do not name a control threshold, chemistry advantage or compatibility promise that has not been verified.
chapters.cn: 电芯、模组、电池包和完整户储系统不是同一层级。化学体系只是一个分类，实际还要看管理保护、输出能力、环境、保修和支持。BMS 保护与整套系统的能量调度各有作用；不能因为客户需要更多功率，就指导绕过保护或混接未经确认的电池。

chapters.en: Storage performance over time: SOC, SOH, cycles, throughput and reserve
chapters.zh: 储能随时间变化：电量、健康、循环、吞吐量和预留
chapters.intents: SOC, SOH, DoD, battery ageing, calendar life, cycle life; 荷电状态 健康状态 放电深度 老化 循环寿命
chapters.foundation: Calendar ageing and cycling describe different influences on storage life. Temperature, state of charge and operating profile can affect the result. Years, cycles and cumulative energy are therefore different ways to describe a battery's use and limitations. [D09]
body: SOC describes the present charge estimate relative to a reference. SOH describes condition relative to another reference, often an earlier or nominal state. A fully charged older battery can therefore hold less energy than when it was new. Neither percentage by itself states the permitted discharge power.

Depth of discharge describes how much of a reference capacity has been used. An equivalent full-cycle measure aggregates partial use according to a defined method; it is not necessarily a counter incremented every time a charger starts. When reviewing a lifecycle figure, ask about its conditions and endpoint.

Throughput concerns accumulated energy over many operations. A warranty can use years, throughput, cycles or a combination. Compare the applicable written terms rather than dividing a laboratory cycle figure by the number of calendar days and reporting the result as a guaranteed service life.

Backup reserve and usable capacity need clear boundaries. A reserve held for a future outage may reduce routine daily discharge, but it is not the same as a product's permanent inaccessible capacity. Settings and outage behaviour differ. Explain the purpose of the reserve before discussing a customer preference.

Health estimates are useful context, not a replacement for support evaluation. If a customer reports an unexpected change, gather the visible observation and circumstances through the appropriate channel. Do not prescribe calibration cycles, deeply discharge a battery or reset a monitor in order to make a percentage look right.
chapters.check: Clarify which quantity is being compared, the reference capacity, and whether the question is about present runtime, routine operation or warranty conditions.
chapters.cn: SOC 是当前电量估计，SOH 是相对参考状态的健康程度，DoD 是已放出的比例。循环、运行年限和累计电量各有定义，不能互相替代。备电预留与永久不可用容量也不同。遇到异常读数，应记录现象并交给支持人员，不能在线要求客户深度放电或重置校准。

chapters.en: Energy-management modes and the trade-offs between savings and resilience
chapters.zh: 能量管理模式：节省电费与备电韧性的取舍
chapters.intents: self-consumption, reserve, time of use, grid charge, export control; 自发自用 备电预留 分时电价 电网充电
chapters.foundation: Energy-management controls decide when supported sources and storage contribute. The available modes depend on the selected equipment and arrangements. The word optimisation does not establish a local tariff, external control programme or free-energy opportunity. [Company scope and approved foundations]
body: Self-consumption aims to use more generated energy within the property. The system may use solar directly, charge storage with a surplus and discharge later within its limits. This is an energy-flow strategy; the financial result still depends on the tariff, costs and what would otherwise happen to the energy.

Backup reserve prioritises a later event that may or may not occur. Holding more energy can improve preparedness when an outage begins, while leaving less storage available for daily shifting. Discuss this as a customer objective rather than declaring one percentage correct for all households.

Time-based operation only has its intended economic meaning when the relevant prices and permissions exist. A system might be technically able to charge from the grid but have no attractive price difference to exploit. Losses, usage changes and purchase conditions belong in the comparison.

Export limits or low demand can influence how much solar is used at a moment. If a battery is full and household demand is small, unused generating potential may be limited rather than visibly produced and discarded. A low app value therefore needs context before it is called a hardware failure.

Automatic modes should be understood through their documented priorities. Ask the installer to explain normal operation, outage operation and low-energy behaviour. The assistant can translate those concepts into plain language, but cannot confirm a live setting or authorise a parameter change without the actual model and support process.
chapters.check: Separate the customer's goal from the setting they propose. Ask whether the priority is daily savings, selected backup loads or readiness for longer interruptions.
chapters.cn: 同一套电池可能用于日常自用，也可能把更多能量留给停电。预留越多与日常可用越多之间存在取舍。分时策略要有真实适用的电价和设备功能，电网充电也不是免费能源。客服先了解客户目标，再解释模式，不替客户擅自修改设备参数。

chapters.en: System architectures: AC/DC coupling, backup boundaries and additional sources
chapters.zh: 系统架构：交直流耦合、备电边界与其他电源
chapters.intents: AC coupling, DC coupling, essential loads, whole house, generator, phase, restart; 交流耦合 直流耦合 备电回路 发电机 相数 重启
chapters.foundation: The location of conversion stages and control equipment determines how sources interact. A backup system also needs an appropriate separation from the utility and support for its intended circuits. A diagram that includes all devices does not by itself establish a supported operating arrangement. [Approved architecture foundations]
body: AC-coupled and DC-coupled describe connection approaches at a system level. Either may be relevant to a particular project, especially where solar already exists. The useful comparison is the supported energy path, conversion, controls and integration scope, not a claim that one acronym is universally superior.

An existing installation adds constraints that a new design may not have. Identify the present inverter and battery equipment, the customer's desired change and any backup requirement. Do not assume a new battery can be attached merely because its nominal voltage appears compatible.

Backup has a boundary. Essential-load arrangements identify selected circuits; wider arrangements still have energy, power and phase-dependent limits. Ask the proposal to explain what is inside that boundary and what happens when several large appliances request power together.

Generator integration is another compatibility question, not a default accessory. The generator, inverter, controls and electrical arrangement need review. Sol & Tide can assess the question according to its published service information, but the assistant cannot approve every generator or provide connection instructions.

Restart and transfer are separate behaviours. The speed of switching from a healthy grid does not establish what happens after low-energy shutdown, and neither establishes uninterrupted service to every sensitive load. Ask for the documented behaviour that matches the customer's concern rather than using a broad 'backup' label.
chapters.check: A useful architecture enquiry states what is already installed, which sources are intended, which circuits matter and the required operating situations. Detailed design and connection work remain professional tasks.
chapters.cn: 交直流耦合说明的是系统连接与转换方式，不是简单的好坏标签。备电必须明确支持哪些回路、相数和负载组合。发电机兼容、切换速度、空电后重启分别是不同能力，要逐项确认，不能因为系统被称为“混合”就全部默认支持。

chapters.en: Household load profiles: appliances, coincidence and daily routines
chapters.zh: 家庭负载画像：家电、同时使用与生活节奏
chapters.intents: load profile, air conditioning, refrigerator, cooking, pump, EV; 用电曲线 空调 冰箱 厨房 水泵 电动车
chapters.foundation: A useful load description distinguishes input power, accumulated energy and the time of use. Cooling output is not electrical input, and intermittent or variable-speed operation makes a nameplate-only energy estimate uncertain. [D10]
body: Build a load picture around activities. Breakfast, work, cooling, laundry and evening cooking create different combinations. A monthly total hides those combinations. Two homes using the same monthly kWh may need different solar-to-storage balances because their demand occurs at different times.

Air conditioning requires more than a count of units or their cooling ratings. Relevant information includes the actual electrical characteristics, expected operating hours, cycling or variable operation and whether units start or run together. The question 'Can it run an air conditioner?' must therefore be narrowed to a meaningful operating scenario.

Refrigeration is often an important backup priority, but its compressor does not necessarily operate continuously at a single power level. A documented or measured energy total helps with the energy side; starting capability still needs a separate check. Do not turn a yearly label average into a guarantee for every hot day or outage.

Short-duration appliances can matter to output power even when their daily energy is modest. Conversely, a modest continuous load can become significant across many hours. Compare both dimensions before deciding which appliances are optional during backup.

Future loads belong in the discussion. An EV, additional cooling equipment or a new household routine can change the demand profile. The assistant should record these plans as inputs for the team, not automatically enlarge every package or promise that existing wiring and equipment can accommodate them.
chapters.check: Use a simple list: appliance or activity, input power if known, desired operating period, must-run priority, and simultaneous-use notes. Avoid requesting unsafe measurements or a lengthy compulsory intake before answering basic questions.
chapters.cn: 家庭用电要同时看“功率多大、用多久、什么时候用、哪些一起用”。空调制冷量不能当输入功率，冰箱平均电量也不能说明启动需求。短时大功率和长期小负载都会影响选型。新增电动车、空调或生活习惯变化，应提前告诉团队评估。

chapters.en: A sizing method: objectives, constraints and scenario comparison
chapters.zh: 选型方法：目标、约束与场景对比
chapters.intents: system sizing, battery sizing, budget, roof limit, essential loads; 系统选型 电池选型 预算 备电时长
chapters.foundation: Project sizing combines a generating profile, load profile, storage behaviour and equipment constraints. No single number, such as room count, monthly spend or battery capacity, establishes all of these. The workflow below is an original customer-facing planning framework.
body: Start with the objective. Reducing routine grid purchases, supporting essentials during an outage and aiming for longer autonomy are related but different goals. State which is primary and what level of performance the customer hopes to discuss. Avoid assuming a budget enquiry means whole-house outage protection.

Then separate the constraints: usable installation area, site conditions, electrical compatibility, required simultaneous power, energy required over the target period and budget. Some constraints cannot be exchanged for one another. More stored energy, for example, does not remove a converter power ceiling.

Compare scenarios with the same assumptions. A basic comparison might hold the essential loads and target hours constant while changing storage. Another might hold equipment constant while distinguishing daytime-heavy and evening-heavy use. If both equipment and assumptions change, explain which change drives the result.

Treat average use and difficult conditions explicitly. An annual energy balance can look favourable while a particular evening or weak-sun period still requires grid energy. Outage planning also depends on the charge available when the outage begins. State the starting conditions before presenting a result.

Translate the comparison into questions for the proposal. Which loads are included? What energy and power boundary is being quoted? Which scope is confirmed and which site details remain uncertain? The assistant's role is to prepare a clearer assessment conversation, not to produce a final engineering design from incomplete chat information.
chapters.check: When a customer asks for a recommendation, identify the missing fact with the greatest effect and ask one focused question. Use a package as a discussion starting point, not as a confirmed fit.
chapters.cn: 先明确目标，再列约束，最后在相同假设下比较方案。省电费、关键负载备电和长时间离网不是同一个目标；屋顶、同时功率、需要电量和预算也不能互相替代。客服可以整理比较思路，但最终配置需要现场和设备资料支持。

chapters.en: Calculation discipline: units, boundaries, assumptions and uncertainty
chapters.zh: 计算方法：单位、边界、假设与不确定性
chapters.intents: calculate runtime, battery charging, solar energy, losses, reserves; 计算 续航 充电 损耗 预留 假设
chapters.foundation: Energy accounting requires consistent units, time periods and measurement boundaries. Calculations in this chapter are original hypothetical teaching examples. They are not measured local data, a Sol & Tide configuration or an installation recommendation.
body: Define what each input represents before multiplying it. Is battery energy nominal DC capacity, usable DC capacity or energy actually available at the load? Is a power figure rated, measured at a moment or averaged over a period? These distinctions often matter more than adding more decimal places.

For a constant load, E = P × t. If power changes, add the energy of the separate periods. A load using 0.4 kW for three hours and 0.8 kW for two hours consumes 2.8 kWh in that simplified profile. The calculation does not include unspecified appliances or conversion losses.

Runtime = available delivered energy / average load is a useful teaching relationship. It does not prove that the output equipment can start or sustain the load. Check the power constraint separately. A large energy figure can coexist with insufficient instantaneous power.

Apply a loss or reserve allowance once, at the boundary for which it is defined. If an input is already usable delivered energy, subtracting the same allowance again understates it. If a quoted figure is nominal, ignoring a relevant limit can overstate it. State uncertainty when the boundary is not known.

Charging time needs net charging power, not array nameplate capacity. Household demand, available sunlight and the charging limit may constrain it. A five-hour arithmetic result at constant charging power does not mean every cloudy day will replenish the battery in five clock hours.

Present scenarios rather than false precision. Changing demand, starting SOC, reserve or available solar can each alter the result. Where important inputs are unknown, explain the relationship and ask the team to confirm the actual values instead of fabricating a precise backup duration.
chapters.check: Every numerical answer should state its inputs and assumptions, distinguish hypothetical from actual data, and mention any separate power constraint relevant to the question.
chapters.cn: 所有计算先确认单位和边界。额定值、实测瞬时值、平均值不能混用；标称电量与负载端可用电量也不同。损耗和预留不能重复扣除。续航计算之外还要检查功率是否足够，充电计算要用扣除负载后的净充电功率。示例数字不代表客户系统的真实表现。

chapters.en: Electricity bills and project economics: a transparent comparison
chapters.zh: 账单与经济性：清楚比较节省、投资和备电价值
chapters.intents: bill, tariff, payback, return, fixed charge, export, finance; 电费 电价 回本 固定费用 上网收益 融资
chapters.foundation: Simple payback is a limited comparison that does not include the time value of money. Wider economic comparisons may account for future cash flows and costs. Storage economics also depend on energy throughput, replacement and operating assumptions. [D11, D12]
body: Begin with the bill boundary. Grid energy, fixed charges, taxes or unrelated services are not interchangeable inputs. A solar system can change one part without eliminating the whole invoice. The company calculator is a planning aid with stated assumptions, not a live tariff feed or a substitute for a proposal.

Distinguish the financial use of each unit of solar energy. Energy used directly, energy shifted through a battery and energy exported may have different values. A stored kWh is not automatically an additional free kWh, because charging, losses and the alternative use of the energy matter.

Compare alternatives incrementally. If a battery is added to a solar proposal, compare the extra battery cost with the extra benefit it creates rather than attributing all solar savings to the battery. At the same time, acknowledge that outage preparedness can have value the customer does not measure only through a bill.

Use internally consistent hypothetical values when explaining arithmetic. A project cost of 20,000 currency units and annual net savings of 2,000 would give a ten-year simple payback under a constant-savings assumption. Those numbers are not local prices or a forecast, and the calculation omits financing and changing conditions unless explicitly added.

Ask about uncertainty before reporting a return. Tariffs, weather, usage, maintenance and replacement can change outcomes. A more detailed model also needs a stated period and financial assumptions. The assistant should explain what is missing rather than inventing a discount rate, finance offer or guaranteed return.
chapters.check: For a personal purchase decision, use the correct regional calculator and a tailored proposal. Do not transplant a foreign subsidy, export credit, time-of-use tariff or financing term into company advice.
chapters.cn: 先拆清账单，再区分直接自用、储能后使用和出口电量的价值。比较加电池的收益时，要看增加的成本和增加的收益，不能把全部光伏节省都归给电池。简单回本不等于完整投资分析，也不代表保证收益；备电价值可单独讨论。

chapters.en: Monitoring literacy: what the dashboard can and cannot prove
chapters.zh: 看懂监控：仪表盘可以说明什么、不能证明什么
chapters.intents: monitoring, graph, kW, kWh, import, export, SOC, timestamp; 监控 曲线 电网购电 自用 电量 时间戳
chapters.foundation: Monitoring systems can report different quantities at different boundaries and update intervals. A local display, an inverter portal and the utility bill need not show the same thing. Battery-state and runtime displays also depend on the product's estimation method and available data. [D13]
body: Read the metric name before interpreting the number. Generation is not household consumption; grid import is not all energy used; export is not all unused sunlight; battery charging power is not its stored capacity. Comparing unrelated metrics can create the appearance of a problem when the readings are simply about different flows.

Align time periods. A daily total, a live reading and a billing-period total cannot be directly compared. Also check whether a graph is cumulative energy or sampled power, and whether its timestamps and timezone match the period the customer is discussing.

A power-flow diagram is a simplified representation. Devices may update at different moments, and some data may be estimated. Small or transient discrepancies require context. A screenshot alone is not proof of faulty metering, an electrical defect or unauthorised energy use.

Treat app savings as an estimate with tariff and measurement assumptions. The utility bill can include charges the app does not model, and it may not show all behind-the-meter use. Ask which values and dates are being compared before concluding that expected savings have disappeared.

When collecting a support report, ask for observable facts: what changed, when it happened, which devices or readings were affected and whether an alert is shown. Use a supported channel for relevant screenshots. Passwords, private access links and unnecessary account information are not required for a general explanation.
chapters.check: The assistant cannot log into equipment or inspect live telemetry in this setup. Interpret the concept, record the observation and direct case-specific verification to support.
chapters.cn: 监控数据要同时看指标名称、时间范围、单位和测量边界。光伏发电不等于家庭总用电，电网购电也不是全部能量来源。实时功率、每日累计电量和账单周期数据不能直接混比。截图只能提供线索，不能据此判定某个元件损坏或电表有误。

chapters.en: Operation and maintenance: observations, professional checks and support
chapters.zh: 运行维护：日常观察、专业检查与支持
chapters.intents: maintenance, cleaning, low output, fault, alarm, commissioning; 维护 清洁 低发电 故障 告警 调试
chapters.foundation: Professional operating and maintenance practices consider performance, condition, documentation and site risks over time. Planned care and meaningful records help distinguish normal variation from changes that need investigation. This is a customer-awareness guide, not a maintenance procedure. [D14]
body: Describe a performance concern before naming its cause. A lower daily yield may coincide with weather, shade, changed operating limits or an equipment issue. An alert is useful information, but the exact meaning and required response belong to the model's documentation and support process.

Use comparisons that answer a real question. A persistent change under comparable conditions deserves a different discussion from one cloudy afternoon. Record the time and visible behaviour instead of repeatedly changing settings to see whether the graph improves.

Cleaning decisions depend on the site and equipment. Dirt or debris can affect light access, but the assistant should not prescribe climbing, washing methods, tools or chemicals. Ask the team about a suitable scope and qualified service, including any access constraints.

Keep a handover record and a history of significant observations. Equipment model, installation documentation, relevant error text and the agreed support contact can be more useful than a large batch of unlabelled screenshots. Do not erase history or reset equipment just to simplify the report.

Separate explanation from action. A chatbot can explain an alert category in general terms without confirming that it has diagnosed the actual event. It cannot claim a repair, technician appointment or warranty approval has been completed when no corresponding workflow has confirmed it.

Sol & Tide's published services include support, cleaning and reinforcement, but the scope and current arrangements must be confirmed with the team. A general maintenance chapter does not create an additional contract or a fixed inspection schedule.
chapters.check: Gather observable facts through a supported contact channel, respect the equipment instructions and escalate case-specific decisions. Do not provide enclosure-opening, disconnection, protection-bypass or repair steps.
chapters.cn: 先描述现象，再判断是否需要专业调查，不要先认定故障原因。维护资料包括型号、时间、告警和运行变化；不要为方便截图而清除历史或重置设备。清洁和检查方式按设备与现场确定。客服能解释概念和整理问题，不能冒充已完成维修、派工或保修审批。

chapters.en: Caribbean conditions: heat, humidity, salt exposure, wind and flooding
chapters.zh: 加勒比地区适应性：高温、湿度、盐雾、风与积水
chapters.intents: Caribbean, heat, humidity, salt, hurricane, wind, flood, corrosion; 加勒比 高温 潮湿 盐雾 飓风 腐蚀
chapters.foundation: Corrosion risks can involve several system materials and components, while severe-weather resilience depends on the complete installation. An enclosure rating does not establish every environmental capability. Site-specific engineering and appropriate operating practices remain important. [D15, D16]
body: Discuss environmental concerns as separate exposures. A shaded equipment location may still experience humidity; a coastal property may require attention to materials; a roof can be suitable for energy collection while presenting challenging wind conditions. One favourable label does not answer all of these questions.

Component certificates and installation performance are different evidence. The module, its mounting, roof attachments, other equipment and the site's exposure form a system. A tested panel alone is not a whole-property hurricane guarantee, and a description such as waterproof is too broad to settle flood suitability.

Hot conditions affect more than comfort. They can influence both electrical performance and the operating environment of equipment. Ask how the proposed design addresses its stated temperature and environmental limits, without inventing a universal reduction percentage or a company's thermal specification.

Preparation and recovery need approved procedures. The assistant can help a customer identify which instructions and contacts to have available, but must not improvise shutdown, reconnection or inspection steps before or after severe weather. The actual equipment condition matters.

Keep country-specific rules separate from general climate education. Information from U.S. or Australian technical sources helps explain risk categories, not local approval or insurance coverage. Antigua and Barbuda and Dominica require their own project discussions; the assistant should not assert a local permitting outcome from a foreign reference.
chapters.check: Ask what exposure concerns the customer and direct them to the team for the relevant product documents and site design. Never promise immunity to a category of weather.
chapters.cn: 高温、湿度、盐雾、风和积水是不同暴露，不能用一个“户外”标签全部覆盖。组件测试、外壳等级与整套系统抗风或防淹能力不同。加勒比项目应结合具体屋顶、材料和设备条件评估；国外资料用于解释风险，不代表本地审批、保险或抗灾承诺。

chapters.en: From enquiry to proposal and handover: understanding each project stage
chapters.zh: 从咨询到方案与交付：理解每个阶段
chapters.intents: assessment, quotation, site visit, proposal, payment, installation, warranty; 评估 报价 勘察 安装 交付 保修
chapters.foundation: A preliminary enquiry, an assessment, a written proposal, confirmed scheduling and completed handover are different stages. This chapter is an original explanation of useful project distinctions, not a newly promised Sol & Tide workflow or service deadline.
body: The first enquiry establishes enough context to discuss the project: location, main electricity needs, backup priorities and any existing equipment. It should not require the customer to understand every technical parameter before receiving basic help.

Assessment reduces uncertainty. The team may need property and equipment information to decide what can be proposed. A preliminary calculation or package choice is not the same as confirming roof suitability, connection arrangements or all installation work.

A proposal should make the particular offer clear. Customers can ask about equipment, supported loads, scope, exclusions, assumptions, warranty responsibilities, commercial terms and the steps still requiring confirmation. The assistant should explain these categories without making up their contents.

Scheduling follows actual commitments and available arrangements. Sending a form or opening a link does not allocate equipment, reserve a date or approve a technician visit. If the customer asks whether something has been booked, the assistant must use the company's contact route rather than pretending to inspect an internal calendar.

Handover is about understanding the installed system and how to obtain support. Ask for the relevant operating information, monitoring arrangements and written records. Customer education should explain which documents to keep, while the team confirms what is actually provided.

Throughout the journey, changing requirements may change the scope. A request for another air conditioner on backup is not merely a wording edit if it alters energy and power needs. Record the change and have it reviewed instead of silently extending an old estimate.
chapters.check: Identify which stage the customer is at and what evidence confirms it. Refer personal order, payment, schedule or warranty questions to the team.
chapters.cn: 咨询、评估、正式方案、排期和交付分别代表不同状态。提交表单不等于预约成功，初步套餐也不等于现场条件已经确认。报价中的设备、范围、假设、商业条款和未决事项应写清楚。客户需求改变时要重新评估，不能把原估算自动扩大。

chapters.en: Customer decision journeys and useful next steps
chapters.zh: 客户决策路径：怎样找到有用的下一步
chapters.intents: beginner, comparison, first solar, existing system, rental, new home; 新手 比较方案 已有系统 租房 新建房 咨询
chapters.foundation: Useful guidance responds to the customer's current question before asking for more data. This chapter applies the company's public information to common decision situations; it does not add service availability or authorise access to personal records.
body: For a newcomer, start with the difference between generation, storage and the grid. Connect the explanation to a concern such as evening use or outages. Offer the relevant regional how-it-works page when it helps; do not require registration or a full electricity bill to explain the basics.

For someone comparing options, organise the comparison around needs and boundaries. Clarify whether the headline figure is panel power, inverter output or battery energy. Encourage a consistent scope and ask the team about the actual proposal rather than recommending a brand that appears only in an educational source.

For a customer ready for an assessment, use the property's island already established in the conversation. Offer the appropriate regional consultation page or WhatsApp according to their preference. Ask only the next useful question instead of repeating known details or imposing a long chat questionnaire.

For an existing-system enquiry, separate a general concept from a case-specific decision. An expansion, generator integration or fault needs actual equipment context. The assistant can help the customer describe the issue but cannot inspect live operation or promise a compatible modification.

For an unsupported or uncertain situation, be specific about what is unknown. A project outside the listed regions, an unconfirmed commercial application or a financing question should go to the team for confirmation. Avoid turning uncertainty into either a fabricated offer or a claim that service is definitely impossible.

When a person is requested, distinguish a contact link from an actual transfer. WhatsApp is another channel; platform-native handoff may have its own behaviour. The customer should receive a truthful next step rather than a claim that someone has already been notified when that has not been confirmed.
chapters.check: Answer first, use known context, offer one relevant next step and state which decisions require the team. Identity questions should use the approved company-customised AI identity.
chapters.cn: 新手先讲原理，比较方案先澄清指标，准备咨询时给对应地区入口，已有系统则收集实际设备背景。未知业务条件要说清哪里需要确认。提供 WhatsApp 链接与平台真正转人工不是同一动作，不能把一句回复说成已通知或已预约。

chapters.en: Long-term ownership, sustainability and future changes
chapters.zh: 长期持有：维护、可持续性与未来变化
chapters.intents: lifecycle, recycling, replacement, moving, warranty transfer, future loads; 生命周期 回收 更换 搬家 保修转移 未来负载
chapters.foundation: Solar and storage equipment has an operating life and an eventual management or replacement stage. Recovery and recycling options depend on equipment, location and available services. General environmental benefits do not establish a company take-back promise or a quantified emissions result. [D17]
body: View the system as a long-term asset with records and responsibilities. Keep the agreed equipment and scope information, applicable warranties, support details and relevant operating history. This helps future professional work and makes it easier to distinguish an original promise from a later assumption.

Components need not have identical lifetimes or replacement conditions. A module performance warranty, an equipment defect warranty, a battery retained-capacity term and installation coverage answer different questions. The assistant should help the customer read those distinctions, not invent one universal 'system warranty'.

A change in property ownership raises questions that hardware alone cannot answer. Ask about equipment ownership, existing contracts, documentation and any transfer conditions. The presence of installed solar is not proof that every obligation or service arrangement automatically transfers.

Future needs can change. More cooling, an EV, a home office or different occupancy may affect both energy and power requirements. Expansion depends on the existing design and compatibility, not just buying a larger battery. Capture the intended change and have it assessed.

Environmental comparisons also need boundaries. A claim about avoided emissions requires a stated baseline and relevant assumptions; it should not be inferred from a generic kWh figure using an invented factor. Similarly, do not describe a product as impact-free simply because it operates without fuel combustion on the roof.

At end of life, ask qualified providers and the local team about safe handling and available options. The knowledge base does not confirm local collection services or that Sol & Tide takes back every panel or battery. Do not replace professional removal and disposal planning with a DIY procedure.
chapters.check: For ownership, warranty, replacement or environmental questions, separate documented facts from assumptions and confirm the actual local service arrangements.
chapters.cn: 长期持有要保留设备、范围、保修、支持和运行记录。不同部件和不同保修并不等同，搬家或转让也不能默认所有服务自动转移。新增负载与扩容需再评估。减碳数字需要基准和假设，回收与更换也要确认本地渠道，不能编造公司回收承诺。

glossary.definition: An accumulated quantity that can be generated, transferred, stored or used; specify the time period and measurement boundary.
The rate of electrical energy transfer at a moment or under defined operating conditions.
A unit of power; read it with the device and condition to which the rating or measurement refers.
One thousand watts; used for generating, charging, discharging or load power, not stored energy.
One thousand kilowatts; a scale unit, not a different kind of electricity.
Energy corresponding to one watt sustained for one hour; a measure of quantity rather than instantaneous rate.
One thousand watt-hours; commonly used for household consumption, generation and battery energy.
A solar power rating at reference conditions, not a guarantee of continuous roof output.
Electrical operation with current in one direction; the DC side still needs compatible voltage, current and protection.
Electrical operation with periodically changing direction; household compatibility includes the relevant supply characteristics.
An electrical potential difference; matching a nominal voltage alone does not establish complete equipment compatibility.
The rate of electric-charge flow; a current rating requires the corresponding equipment and conditions.
A charge quantity; nominal voltage is also needed for an approximate nominal-energy calculation.
A unit of apparent power in AC equipment; do not automatically treat its numerical value as watts.
One thousand VA; compare both real-power and apparent-power constraints where specified.
The relationship between real and apparent power under the stated conditions; relevant to some equipment ratings.
A stated reference or naming value, not necessarily the exact live reading or usable delivered quantity.
A specified performance or limit under defined conditions; those conditions belong with the number.
Output supported over the stated operating duration and conditions, distinct from a temporary peak.
A temporary capability subject to its permitted duration and conditions, not sustained running power.
An appliance or group consuming power; identify both instantaneous needs and energy over time.
The power needed by loads operating together; different from simply adding their daily energy totals.
The pattern of operation and rest or different power states; relevant when estimating energy use.
Demand that persists across much of the period being studied; its actual level is site-dependent.
The changing demand over time, used to understand both coincidence and energy.
The agreed subset of appliances or circuits prioritised for backup; inclusion must be confirmed.
The period a defined load can be supplied under stated energy, power and operating assumptions.
Time supported without the external source being considered; the assumed weather and starting energy matter.
An appliance's demand while starting, which may differ from its normal running requirement.
Thermal cooling output; not the same as an air conditioner's electrical input.
A thermal rate commonly used for cooling capacity; it does not directly specify electrical consumption.
Electricity required by equipment under stated conditions, distinct from thermal or mechanical output.
A household load with charger, vehicle, timing and energy requirements; backup capability is not automatic.
Battery storage together with management, conversion and other required equipment for the intended application.
An individual electrochemical unit; its characteristics are not automatically the whole system's delivered performance.
A product-specific grouping of cells; compatibility and management depend on the equipment design.
An assembled storage unit or supported grouping; distinguish its limits from those of one cell.
Conversion of light into electricity using photovoltaic materials and devices.
Use of solar energy as heat; different equipment and output from a PV electrical system.
An individual photovoltaic converting element, usually packaged with others in a module.
A packaged photovoltaic generating product containing cells and protective construction.
An arrangement of multiple modules forming the generating portion of a system.
A broad photovoltaic material family; the exact module model still determines specifications.
A crystalline-material description; not a complete guarantee of yield, durability, price or suitability.
A material-structure description; compare actual products and conditions rather than the label alone.
A family using thin photovoltaic material layers; technology category does not establish an offered company product.
A module designed to collect useful light from both sides; extra yield depends on rear illumination.
A cell structure combining conversion layers; research capability is not proof of a quoted product's availability.
Power-conversion equipment used to provide an appropriate AC output from a compatible DC source.
An inverter serving the PV conversion function; storage or backup support must be separately established.
Compatible equipment for battery charging and household AC supply; product functions differ.
Equipment combining or coordinating supported solar and battery functions; the label alone does not guarantee every backup feature.
An inverter converting energy from groups of panels; layout and operating conditions affect the design.
Panel-level conversion equipment; compatibility, monitoring and costs remain model-specific.
Panel-level DC control used with a compatible system; it does not create missing sunlight.
A control process seeking a useful array operating point as electrical and environmental conditions change.
An operating point on a current-voltage relationship at which available electrical power is maximised.
A system architecture connecting solar and storage through a supported DC-side arrangement.
An architecture where solar and storage conversion systems interact through an AC-side arrangement.
Operating alongside a utility supply under the relevant equipment and connection arrangement.
Operating independently of the utility; adequate generation, storage and other sources need specific design.
Operation of a separated electrical area; supported backup requires a controlled and appropriate boundary.
Protection associated with preventing unintended independent energisation; not a user setting to bypass.
Operation referenced to an existing supply signal; do not infer independent backup capability.
A supported ability to establish a local electrical reference; applicability depends on the complete design.
Starting a system without the external reference or supply being considered; exact capability is model-specific.
The interruption or transition performance between operating situations; not necessarily zero.
Equipment intended for specified backup and power-continuity functions; compare actual ratings and topology.
Which parts of a property's supply and circuits are supported; one connection does not establish all-phase backup.
A constraint on electricity sent to the utility under the applicable arrangement.
Reduction of generating output when available energy cannot or should not be converted or used.
Reduced light access from an obstruction; the effect depends on timing, layout and equipment.
Solar power incident per unit area at a moment; distinguish it from accumulated solar energy.
Solar energy received per area over a stated period; the period must be specified.
An energy-equivalent representation of changing sunlight, not a fixed interval of continuous peak generation.
The orientation plane at which light relevant to the array is considered or measured.
Light arriving along the direct solar path, distinguished from diffuse components.
Light reaching a surface after atmospheric scattering; cloud conditions change its contribution.
Light redirected by surrounding surfaces; geometry and materials affect whether it reaches a module.
A surface-reflection characteristic used in modelling; not a guaranteed bifacial gain.
A directional description used with a defined convention; specify the convention before comparing values.
An installation's inclination relative to a reference plane; part of the site and layout assessment.
Deposited material affecting light access or operation; cleaning decisions remain site and equipment dependent.
The temperature relevant to cell behaviour; it is not automatically the weather report's ambient temperature.
The surrounding air condition, distinct from internal cell or component temperatures.
Reference conditions used for specified photovoltaic ratings; not a description of every rooftop hour.
A stated modelling or test reference that must be interpreted with its conditions and equipment.
Voltage at the open-circuit point under specified conditions; not a normal power-producing operating point.
Current at a defined short-circuit test point; not a measurement the chatbot should ask a visitor to perform.
Voltage at the relevant maximum-power point, paired with the corresponding current.
Current at the maximum-power point, paired with its operating voltage.
A power value at specified conditions; do not form it from unrelated voltage and current maxima.
The change of a specified parameter with temperature under the stated reference and units.
Capping of output at a relevant conversion limit when available input would exceed it.
Electrical energy produced over the stated period and boundary; distinguish gross generation from grid export.
Energy divided by the relevant installed capacity over a stated period; assumptions and boundaries still matter.
An evaluation using matched units, periods and conditions rather than isolated headline numbers.
The extent a system or function is available during the defined period, distinct from energy produced.
Stored-energy capability at a stated boundary and condition; not instantaneous output power.
Capacity made available within the specified product or operating boundary.
A stated reference capacity that may differ from usable energy delivered to loads.
An estimate of current charge relative to the applicable capacity reference.
A condition estimate relative to an earlier or nominal reference; its method is product-specific.
The proportion used relative to the stated capacity reference during the period or cycle.
An accounting measure aggregating battery use under a defined method, not necessarily every charge event.
Cumulative energy charged or delivered over time according to the stated definition.
Changes associated with time and conditions, distinct from counting cycles alone.
A test- or condition-dependent use measure to an identified endpoint, not an unconditional year guarantee.
Recovered energy divided by charging energy for a defined cycle and measurement boundary.
Energy not delivered through a conversion stage; apply its allowance only at the relevant boundary.
Energy used while equipment remains in a low-power or ready state.
Battery monitoring and protective management; its limits are not to be bypassed through general advice.
Higher-level coordination of supported energy sources, storage and loads.
A product-specific management function addressing cell-state differences; not proof of exact SOC estimation.
Energy held for a possible outage under supported settings; distinguish it from a permanent unusable margin.
Functions carried out by the installed equipment, distinct from remote visibility or cloud-dependent features.
Device software with model-specific support and update requirements.
Reported measurements or status; data access is not available to this assistant in the current setup.
The period or update pattern behind reported data, relevant to interpreting graphs.
Where and what a measurement includes, such as inverter output, household loads or grid exchange.
Energy or power received from the utility at the relevant measurement boundary.
Energy or power sent to the utility under a supported and permitted arrangement.
Solar energy used within the property under an identified definition and boundary.
The portion of the household's defined demand supplied by the considered on-site sources.
The actual charging structure applying to the property; a foreign example does not establish it.
A bill component not simply proportional to the kWh under discussion.
A bill component calculated from relevant measured use under the tariff.
Compensation, if applicable, under the actual utility arrangement; not an automatic company promise.
Prices varying by defined periods; its existence and terms must be confirmed locally.
Initial cost divided by a defined annual net benefit under stated assumptions; it omits several financial effects.
An assumed rate used to compare cash flows across time; the assistant must not invent it for a personal project.
Present-valued future net cash flows less the relevant investment under stated assumptions.
The extra benefit of one change compared with a defined baseline, distinct from the whole project's benefit.
The equipment and work actually included in a particular agreed offer.
A stated item outside the agreed scope; it should not be silently assumed included.
Written coverage for specified equipment conditions or defects, subject to its terms.
Written coverage for specified output or retention conditions, not a universal yield or bill promise.
Written coverage addressing specified installation work; confirm actual responsibilities and terms.
A capacity condition measured relative to a stated reference and under stated criteria.
Whether and how written coverage can apply after an ownership change; do not assume automatic transfer.
Professional verification and setup for the intended installation, distinct from merely powering a device.
The transfer of relevant operating information and records, according to the agreed project.
A classification of specified enclosure protection, not proof against every environmental exposure.
Material deterioration affected by the environment and component interactions.
An electrochemical risk involving dissimilar materials under suitable conditions; assessment belongs to qualified design and care.
Forces relevant to the complete mounting and structure, not just a panel's power rating.
The equipment and arrangements securing the array; site-specific suitability must be assessed.
Review of relevant property, electrical and environmental conditions for the proposed project.
A model-specific technical document whose conditions and definitions accompany its values.
Evidence applicable to a defined product or test scope; not automatic project approval.
Supported operation of the complete equipment combination, not merely matching a nominal label.
A request to discuss needs; it does not itself confirm a booking or installation.
An assumption-based planning result before all project details are confirmed.
A particular written offer or scope that must be reviewed on its actual terms.
An arrangement requiring real confirmation, not just a submitted form or a chatbot statement.
Invented inputs used to teach a relationship; not measured data or an actual offer.
Comparing outcomes when selected assumptions change while identifying what remains fixed.
Sol & Tide Energy's specially customised customer AI assistant, distinct from a human teammate.
An actual platform action if configured, distinct from merely providing a contact link.
The approved website, form or email appropriate to the property's island.
Team review of personal or equipment-specific matters beyond public educational answers.

cases.title: Daily energy from several loads
cases.zh: 不同负载的每日电量
cases.given: Hypothetical loads: 0.08 kW of lighting for 5 hours, 0.12 kW of electronics for 4 hours, and 0.6 kW of another load for 2 hours.
cases.steps: Calculate each energy separately and add: 0.08 × 5 = 0.4 kWh; 0.12 × 4 = 0.48 kWh; 0.6 × 2 = 1.2 kWh. Total = 2.08 kWh.
cases.meaning: The energy total says nothing by itself about whether all loads run together. Their simultaneous running power would be 0.8 kW if all three were on, before any separate starting requirement.
cases.limit: Do not apply these invented appliance powers to a customer's actual equipment.
cases.cn: 先分别算每项功率乘时间，再相加得到 2.08 kWh；能量总和与同时功率要分开看。

cases.title: Equal daily energy, different output-power needs
cases.zh: 电量相同，功率需求仍可能不同
cases.given: Home A uses a constant 0.5 kW for 8 hours. Home B uses 2 kW for 2 hours. Ignore all other loads and losses.
cases.steps: Both consume 4 kWh: 0.5 × 8 = 4 and 2 × 2 = 4.
cases.meaning: An energy-only comparison treats the homes as equal, but the specified simultaneous demand is four times higher in B. This is why a monthly kWh total alone cannot establish inverter sizing.
cases.limit: These are intentionally simplified load profiles, not representative usage assumptions for a region.
cases.cn: 两个情形都是 4 kWh，但第二个需要的运行功率更高，不能只用月电量确定逆变器。

cases.title: A defined battery energy window and delivered energy
cases.zh: 明确电量窗口后再算负载端电量
cases.given: A hypothetical storage reference is 10 kWh DC. The agreed example uses the window from 80% to 20% on that same reference. Conversion to the load is assumed to be 90%.
cases.steps: Energy in the chosen window = 10 × (0.8 − 0.2) = 6 kWh DC. Delivered energy = 6 × 0.9 = 5.4 kWh.
cases.meaning: The calculation illustrates why a capacity label, operating window and delivered-energy boundary must be identified separately. At a constant 0.6 kW load, this modelled energy would correspond to 9 hours.
cases.limit: Do not reuse the window or efficiency as a product's actual settings, or deduct them again from a figure that already includes them.
cases.cn: 示例先取 80% 到 20% 的指定窗口，再按假设效率转换，负载端为 5.4 kWh；不能重复扣除已经包含的预留和损耗。

cases.title: Available energy versus a power ceiling
cases.zh: 有足够电量不等于功率够用
cases.given: The load-side energy available in an example is 8 kWh. A constant load asks for 4 kW, but the only supported source has a 3 kW continuous output limit.
cases.steps: The energy-only ratio would be 8 ÷ 4 = 2 hours, but the proposed operating point fails the 3 kW power constraint.
cases.meaning: The two-hour arithmetic is not a feasible runtime promise under the stated source limit. A design review must address the load or supported sources before using that ratio as an outcome.
cases.limit: Do not assume the grid or another converter will supply the shortfall unless that operating arrangement exists.
cases.cn: 8÷4 虽等于 2 小时，但 4 kW 负载已经超过唯一电源的 3 kW 限制，因此不能承诺能运行两小时。

cases.title: Net charging power after daytime loads
cases.zh: 扣除白天负载后的净充电功率
cases.given: Solar supplies a hypothetical constant 4 kW. Loads use 1.5 kW. The charging path can accept the remaining power, and 5 kWh is required at the same energy boundary. Ignore losses.
cases.steps: Net charging power = 4 − 1.5 = 2.5 kW. Arithmetic charging time = 5 ÷ 2.5 = 2 hours.
cases.meaning: Using all 4 kW as charging power would ignore the loads. A real charging estimate also needs changing sunlight, supported charging power and the relevant losses.
cases.limit: Constant power is a teaching assumption, not a forecast of two clock hours on any particular day.
cases.cn: 4 kW 光伏先供 1.5 kW 负载，只剩 2.5 kW 可用于充电；实际还要考虑光照变化与充电限制。

cases.title: Variable air-conditioning power over an evening
cases.zh: 空调功率变化时如何算晚间电量
cases.given: A hypothetical appliance averages 0.4 kW for 4 hours and 1 kW for another 2 hours.
cases.meaning: One constant-power assumption could overstate one period and understate another. A measured or well-supported average over each period is more useful than substituting cooling capacity for electrical input.
cases.limit: The numbers are not a typical consumption figure for any air-conditioner size or a statement about overnight backup.
cases.cn: 分时段计算得到 3.6 kWh，不能把制冷量直接代入，也不能把这个示例当成某型号空调的真实耗电。

cases.title: Using an annual appliance label cautiously
cases.zh: 谨慎使用家电年度能耗标签
cases.given: A hypothetical label states 365 kWh per year under its defined test method.
cases.steps: The arithmetic annual-average daily energy is 365 ÷ 365 = 1 kWh per day.
cases.meaning: This gives a reference average, not the consumption of every actual day. Temperature, use and operating conditions can differ, and the annual figure does not establish starting or instantaneous power.
cases.limit: Do not infer that a battery delivering 1 kWh will always support that appliance for a full day.
cases.cn: 年度标签可换算参考日平均，但不保证每天都一样，也不能说明启动功率或直接承诺备电时长。

cases.title: Vehicle energy versus electricity required at the charging boundary
cases.zh: 车辆获得的能量与充电侧购电
cases.given: A hypothetical vehicle needs 10 kWh added at the defined vehicle boundary. The assumed total charging efficiency from the chosen supply boundary is 90%.
cases.steps: Supply energy required = 10 ÷ 0.9 ≈ 11.111 kWh.
cases.meaning: Dividing by the fraction, rather than multiplying the requirement by it, accounts for the extra input. The result says nothing about supported charging rate or whether a home backup design includes the charger.
cases.limit: The efficiency is illustrative; use the actual vehicle, charger and measurement boundary for a project estimate.
cases.cn: 要让车辆获得 10 kWh，按示例 90% 效率，供电侧需要约 11.11 kWh；效率与功率限制要分别看。

cases.title: Panel-count arithmetic is a rating, not a daily yield
cases.zh: 组件数量只给出额定容量
cases.given: An example array has ten modules each rated at 450 W under the same reference conditions.
cases.steps: Rated DC capacity = 10 × 450 ÷ 1,000 = 4.5 kW.
cases.meaning: The result describes the sum of rated module powers. It does not state roof energy production, inverter output at every moment, battery capacity or the number of appliances that can run.
cases.limit: The example is not a Sol & Tide module or package specification.
cases.cn: 十块 450 W 组件合计额定 4.5 kW，但不能直接由此给出每日发电量、备电时长或负载清单。

cases.title: Temperature sensitivity with an explicitly hypothetical coefficient
cases.zh: 温度系数的假设计算
cases.given: Use a hypothetical power reference of 500 W, a power coefficient of −0.3% per degree C and a 30 degree C increase relative to its reference. Hold other factors fixed.
cases.steps: Relative change = −0.003 × 30 = −0.09. Simplified adjusted power = 500 × (1 − 0.09) = 455 W.
cases.meaning: The example teaches coefficient units and reference differences. It is not a complete PV model and should not be applied to another parameter such as voltage without its own coefficient.
cases.limit: Neither the coefficient nor the temperature difference is a verified specification or local weather assumption.
cases.cn: 温差乘系数后再应用到对应参考参数；示例为 455 W，不能把功率系数随意用于电压或整个系统收益。

cases.title: A simplified resource-to-energy illustration
cases.zh: 从假设太阳能资源估算电量
cases.given: Use a hypothetical 4 kW rating, 4 equivalent full-sun hours and a single assumed overall energy factor of 0.8 for this example.
cases.steps: Illustrative energy = 4 × 4 × 0.8 = 12.8 kWh.
cases.meaning: This is a deliberately compressed model showing why rated power, integrated resource and a stated factor are different inputs. A site forecast requires appropriate data and a clearer treatment of system conditions.
cases.limit: Four sun hours and the 0.8 factor are not published assumptions for Antigua, Dominica or a company package.
cases.cn: 4 kW、4 等效小时和 0.8 因子只是假设，用于解释计算关系，不能直接套用为当地或某套餐的发电承诺。

cases.title: Sequential efficiency stages are multiplied
cases.zh: 连续转换阶段的效率要相乘
cases.given: A hypothetical path has one stage at 95% efficiency followed by a different stage at 90%, with 10 kWh entering the first stage.
cases.steps: Combined fraction = 0.95 × 0.9 = 0.855. Output = 10 × 0.855 = 8.55 kWh.
cases.meaning: The second stage acts on the output of the first. The calculation should not be used if a quoted round-trip figure already includes both stages, because that would count the same losses twice.
cases.limit: These assumed percentages do not describe any offered equipment.
cases.cn: 串联的转换阶段依次作用，示例输出 8.55 kWh；如果总效率已经包含这些环节，就不能再次重复扣除。

cases.title: Self-consumption and self-sufficiency use different denominators
cases.zh: 自用比例与自给比例的分母不同
cases.given: Over the same hypothetical period without storage, PV generates 20 kWh, 12 kWh is used directly at home, and total household demand is 30 kWh.
cases.steps: Direct solar self-consumption = 12 ÷ 20 = 60%. On-site contribution to total demand = 12 ÷ 30 = 40%.
cases.meaning: Both percentages can be correct because they answer different questions. The first concerns use of generation; the second concerns supply of demand. Define boundaries again if storage is included.
cases.limit: Do not describe either percentage as bill savings without the tariff and other costs.
cases.cn: 12/20 是发电中有多少被自用，12/30 是总需求中有多少由现场光伏供应，两者都不直接等于账单节省。

cases.title: The incremental value of shifting surplus energy through storage
cases.zh: 储能转移电量的增量价值
cases.given: Hypothetically, 5 kWh would otherwise be exported at 0.10 currency units/kWh. Storage later delivers 4.5 kWh that avoids purchases at 0.30 currency units/kWh.
cases.steps: Avoided purchase cost = 4.5 × 0.30 = 1.35. Forgone export value = 5 × 0.10 = 0.50. Difference = 0.85 currency units before other costs.
cases.meaning: Count the alternative use of the charging energy and the output boundary. The difference still excludes storage purchase, ageing, maintenance and any other relevant charges.
cases.limit: The example assumes export is available and gives invented prices. It does not establish a local tariff or an investment return.
cases.cn: 比较储能增量收益时，要同时扣掉原本可取得的出口价值，并计入转换后实际交付的电量；示例不是当地价格。

cases.title: A shared conversion ceiling can constrain combined sources
cases.zh: 共用转换设备可能限制合计输出
cases.given: An abstract example has a shared AC output ceiling of 5 kW. The current solar contribution is 4.8 kW and household demand is 6 kW. Other limits are ignored.
cases.steps: Headroom within the shared ceiling is 5 − 4.8 = 0.2 kW. Even if the battery could contribute more on its own, this example's combined path cannot exceed 5 kW.
cases.meaning: Adding independent source ratings would miss a shared bottleneck. Any remaining demand requires another supported source or a different demand arrangement; the assistant cannot infer either.
cases.limit: This is a conceptual limit example, not the wiring or operation of a specific hybrid inverter.
cases.cn: 不能只把光伏和电池各自功率相加；若共用路径上限是 5 kW，合计输出仍受这个上限约束。

cases.title: Whole-project payback versus incremental battery payback
cases.zh: 整项目回本与加电池的增量回本
cases.given: Hypothetical solar-only cost is 20,000 currency units with annual benefit 2,000. Solar-plus-storage cost is 30,000 with annual benefit 2,400. Hold values constant and omit other costs.
cases.steps: Simple ratios are 20,000 ÷ 2,000 = 10 years and 30,000 ÷ 2,400 = 12.5 years. Incremental storage ratio is (30,000 − 20,000) ÷ (2,400 − 2,000) = 25 years.
cases.meaning: Attributing all project benefit to the battery would conceal the incremental comparison. Backup resilience is a separate customer objective that this simple money-only calculation does not value.
cases.limit: This is not a quotation, forecast, recommendation or complete investment model.
cases.cn: 加储能要看增加的成本与增加的收益，不能把全部光伏收益都算给电池；备电价值也不等于这项简单回本计算。

cases.title: Discounting one future cash flow
cases.zh: 未来现金流的折现示例
cases.given: Assume a hypothetical benefit of 1,000 currency units one year from now and an illustrative discount rate of 5%.
cases.steps: Present value = 1,000 ÷ 1.05 ≈ 952.381 currency units.
cases.meaning: The example shows that cash flows at different times can be compared using an explicitly chosen financial assumption. A real analysis would need its full horizon, costs, benefits and a justified rate.
cases.limit: Five percent is not a company financing offer, a required discount rate or a prediction of inflation.
cases.cn: 折现率是需要说明的分析假设；示例 5% 不是融资利率、通胀预测或对客户项目的推荐值。

cases.title: Integrating a time-based power profile
cases.zh: 从分时功率累计电量
cases.given: A hypothetical trace is exactly 1.5 kW for 2 hours and 0.5 kW for 4 hours.
cases.meaning: This relationship holds for the defined intervals. A few screenshots taken during a day do not establish that power stayed constant between them. Meter or monitoring energy totals can provide a different kind of evidence.
cases.limit: Do not integrate sparse observations as if they were complete measured intervals.
cases.cn: 只有已知每段功率和时长时，才能按区间累计；几张截图不能证明截图之间一直保持同样功率。

cases.title: Full charge on a reduced capacity reference
cases.zh: 容量下降后满电仍可能更少
cases.given: A hypothetical battery began with a 10 kWh energy reference. For this illustration its present relevant full-capacity reference is 90% of that original value.
cases.steps: Present full reference = 10 × 0.9 = 9 kWh.
cases.meaning: A display of full charge can refer to the current capacity while health compares with an earlier reference. The example does not define the actual manufacturer's SOC or SOH method.
cases.limit: Do not infer a replacement decision or warranty result from this invented percentage.
cases.cn: 当前满电与最初容量不是同一参照。示例只说明 SOC 与健康参考的区别，不能直接据此决定更换或保修。

cases.title: Prioritising essential energy in a defined outage window
cases.zh: 在指定停电窗口内分配关键负载电量
cases.given: Assume 6 kWh is already available at the load, essentials need 0.25 kW for 8 hours, and an optional load would draw 1 kW. Ignore other energy use and require the separate power limit to be satisfied.
cases.steps: Essential energy = 0.25 × 8 = 2 kWh. Remaining energy = 6 − 2 = 4 kWh, corresponding to 4 hours of the optional 1 kW load in this ideal model.
cases.meaning: A priority plan can distinguish essential service from discretionary use rather than assuming every load runs for the whole outage. Starting demand and simultaneous power remain separate questions.
cases.limit: The example is not an operational instruction, appliance recommendation or actual backup promise.
cases.cn: 先计算关键负载，再看剩余能量可支持多少可选负载；功率与启动限制仍须单独检查，不能把示例当成实际运行安排。
